`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0,
    parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1,
    parameter W = 2**LEVELS
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid[LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc[LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n+1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l+1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n+1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
endmodule

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);
    reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
    reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
    reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
    reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

    assign grant = grant_reg;
    assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
    assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

    wire request_valid;
    wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] request_index;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] request_mask;
    wire masked_request_valid;
    wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] masked_request_index;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_mask;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request = request & mask_reg;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] request_follow;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_follow;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] request_winner;
    wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_winner;

    priority_encoder #(
        .WIDTH(PORTS),
        .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) priority_encoder_inst (
        .input_unencoded(request),
        .output_valid(request_valid),
        .output_encoded(request_index),
        .output_unencoded(request_mask)
    );

    priority_encoder #(
        .WIDTH(PORTS),
        .LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY(ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY)
    ) priority_encoder_masked (
        .input_unencoded(masked_request),
        .output_valid(masked_request_valid),
        .output_encoded(masked_request_index),
        .output_unencoded(masked_request_mask)
    );

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i+1) begin : direct_priority
            if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
                if (i == 0) begin : edge_bit
                    assign request_follow[i] = 1'b0;
                    assign masked_request_follow[i] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : inner_bit
                    assign request_follow[i] = |request[i-1:0];
                    assign masked_request_follow[i] = |masked_request[i-1:0];
                end
            end else begin : high_first
                if (i == PORTS-1) begin : edge_bit
                    assign request_follow[i] = 1'b0;
                    assign masked_request_follow[i] = 1'b0;
                end else begin : inner_bit
                    assign request_follow[i] = |request[PORTS-1:i+1];
                    assign masked_request_follow[i] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:i+1];
                end
            end
            assign request_winner[i] = request[i] & ~request_follow[i];
            assign masked_request_winner[i] = masked_request[i] & ~masked_request_follow[i];
        end
    endgenerate

    wire [PORTS-1:0] rr_winner = masked_request_winner |
        (request_winner & {PORTS{!masked_request_valid}});
    wire [PORTS-1:0] rr_follow = masked_request_follow |
        (request_follow & {PORTS{!masked_request_valid}});

    always @* begin
        grant_next = 0;
        grant_valid_next = 0;
        grant_encoded_next = 0;
        mask_next = mask_reg;

        if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (grant_reg & request)) begin
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid && !(grant_reg & acknowledge)) begin
            grant_next = grant_reg;
            grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
            grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
        end else if (request_valid) begin
            grant_valid_next = 1'b1;
            if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
                grant_next = rr_winner;
                grant_encoded_next = masked_request_valid ? masked_request_index : request_index;
                mask_next = rr_follow;
            end else begin
                grant_next = request_winner;
                grant_encoded_next = request_index;
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        grant_reg <= grant_next;
        grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
        grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
        mask_reg <= mask_next;
        if (rst) begin
            grant_reg <= 0;
            grant_valid_reg <= 0;
            grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
            mask_reg <= 0;
        end
    end
endmodule
`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original round-robin feedback path passes through priority encoding, encoded-index selection, index arithmetic and a variable shift before reaching mask_reg. Grant generation also decodes the encoded index through a variable shift.",
  "rewrite": "Compute strict-priority prefix reductions directly from request and request & mask_reg. These reductions simultaneously provide the next round-robin mask and identify the winning one-hot request. Compute masked and unmasked candidates in parallel, then combine them using masked_request_valid. Retain the original tree encoders for grant_encoded and preserve the existing named registers and their encodings.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to shorten mask_reg feedback substantially by removing encoded-index arithmetic and barrel shifting, and to shorten one-hot grant generation by bypassing index decoding. Actual setup WNS improvement requires synthesis and STA with the specified SKY130HD mapping and constraints; no numerical gain is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel priority-prefix logic while making the original one-hot decoder outputs unused and eligible for synthesis removal. Prefix reductions offer substantial sharing opportunities. No registers, pipeline stages or clock loads are added. Compliance with the 4855.656960um2 area cap and electrical limits requires mapped implementation checks.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves module interfaces, parameters, synchronous reset, registered latency, blocking and acknowledgement semantics, arbitration direction, default outputs and mask retention. The named grant_reg, grant_valid_reg, grant_encoded_reg and mask_reg states remain unchanged. Direct winner and mask formulas are consumed only when requests are valid, preserving idle behavior and the helper encoder's original invalid-input behavior. No initialization assumptions, extra startup cycles, input restrictions, latches or undefined outputs are introduced. Source and mapped equivalence and STA have not been executed here."
}
